newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore shares seen steady while consolidating.
newsitem.headline: Singapore shares seen steady while consolidating.

text.p: Singapore shares are seen holding steady in quiet dealings on Tuesday.
Dealers said prices should hold but further gains would be limited given the uncertainty on Wall Street.
"The Singapore market has been quite resilient. But most of the blue chips have run up," said a local broker.
The Straits Times Industrial Index closed 12.36 points higher at 2,088.14 on Monday.
The Dow closed up 29.84 points at 6555.91, its second firmer session after volatility last week.
